title: Every AI has a fingerprint and here's how to find it #aitools #llm #tech
description:
Can you identify AI models just by asking for a random number? Learn how to spot the difference between LLMs using this simple, accurate fingerprinting technique.

This method allows you to distinguish between various AI systems by analysing their specific number-generation patterns. We walk through the data and show you how to test any model yourself with roughly 80% accuracy.

Subscribe for more practical AI experiments and testing tips.
